1.o: In a future world where invaders from another dimension have driven humanity to live on floating islands in the sea, Hida Kizuna becomes a member of the elite Amaterasu squadron. In order to power up the mech suits of this all-girls combat team, he has to...do lewd things to them!?

2.o: Kizuna is declared the captain of the megafloat's defense squad: the Amaterasu. For his first mission, he's sent to an uninhabited island to scan for needed resources. But what was supposed to be a safe mission turns dangerous when a miscalculation sends them right into a Magitech ambush. Kizuna's Eros gear is dangerously underpowered, and Yurishia is running desperately low on energy...

3.o: Kizuna takes Yurishia on a date through megafloat Japan. They enjoy a day of seeing the sights, from Tokyo to Kyoto. But then Reiri takes Kizuna aside and tells him a horrifying truth: that if the Hybrid Count of the girls reaches zero, the pilot will die. When Aine wants to push herself to the very limit, and a huge fleet ambushes Ataraxia, how can he stop things from getting out of control?

4.o: A huge enemy fleet is bombarding Ataraxia, led by a battleship with a gigantic cannon. Amaterasu does their best to fight them off, but Aine's Hybrid Count is critically low. Kizuna is able to rescue her in the nick of time and take her back to Ataraxia, where he talks with her about her past. He finds out that Aine was also a test subject in Dr. Nayuta's experiments, and that she knows the key to unlocking her lost memories: a more advanced version of the Heart Hybrid called the Climax Hybrid.

5.t: Beauty of the Land of Rubble -BATLANTIS-
5.o: Himekawa is guilt-stricken by her failure to protect the citizens as they boarded the Tokyo megafloat. When a mysterious radio signal is picked up by Ataraxia, she leaps at the chance to perhaps finally save a civilian. But when Amaterasu arrives at the source of the signal, they find an enemy from another world, and one deeply connected to Himekawa's past.

6.o: Himekawa needs more power to fight against the tri-headed dragon that caused her so much trauma in her past. But the pleasure of the Climax Hybrid goes against the strict and disciplined life that she's forced on herself after she failed to protect the people boarding the Tokyo megafloat. It's up to Kizuna to break down the walls she's built up for herself, and teach her to enjoy the ecstasy she needs to defeat the enemy.

7.o: Ataraxia is united with the Masters, the aces of the Western USA megafloat. Despite Yurishia being their former leader, they're very cold to her. Their leader, Scarlet, fights with Yurishia over Kizuna, but their battle is interrupted when another leader from the Batlantis Empire attacks!

8.o: After their defeat by Grabel, Amaterasu needs a new weapon to protect Ataraxia: the Connective Hybrid. To use it, Kizuna will have to perform the climax hybrid with two girls at once! He picks Yurishia and Scarlet, hoping to defuse the tension between them. Will the pleasure be enough to cause them to reunite? And can they retake Guam, and eventually Japan, from the Batlantis empire?

9.o: The eve of the operation to retake Tokyo coincides with the school festival, and Aine is nowhere to be found! Amaterasu is supposed to be giving a big concert performance at the climax of the festival, so Kizuna sets off in search of her. Can he find her and bring her back in time, or will Sylvia have to go instead?

10.o: Kizuna is finally reunited with his mother, who is revealed to be the one who originally sent information on the Eros system to Ataraxia. His mother is working with the Batlantis empire, and is now an enemy of humanity. She tells him to go to Tokyo, where she'll reveal more of her plans. But to break through to occupied Tokyo, Kizuna will need to strengthen his team, which means adding a new member: Sylvia Silkheart. Will young Sylvia be willing to go along with the core install process, and the dangers, and pleasure, that it entails!?

11.o: The attack on Tokyo has begun, and Amaterasu finds itself outgunned by the Batlantis royal guards. It's up to the newly powered-up Sylvia to save her the day with her Hybrid Heart. When the defeated enemy general uses her ultimate attack to summon a black hole that can take out Tokyo, she'll have to rely on her forbidden weapon to save the city.

12.o: In the climatic battle for Tokyo, Aine attempts to perform a climax hybrid to get the power she needs to defeat the Batlantis royal guard. But doing so means facing memories that may be best forgotten...Can she set aside her fears to gain the power she needs? And should she, if the cost may be the loss of her own identity?

5.o: Rafi makes progress on both Nader's case and his relationship with his wife, but Jalal has spousal problems of his own.

6.o: Disaster strikes Jalal. Rafi's marriage deteriorates. Qais needs money for his mother's surgery.

7.o: While Aline calls in a favor from Gibran, Rafi delivers a morally questionable legal defense.

8.o: Rafi's problems at home escalate. Lujain reaches out to Jalal for help, while Gebran finally opens up to Aline.

9.o: Qais investigates a mysterious manuscript while Rafi is assigned a new case, making a fellow lawyer jealous.

10.o: Gebran tries to get to the bottom of Aline's secrets. Qais decides to publish the mysterious novel under his own name.

11.o: Qais signs a book deal with a publishing house. Meanwhile, Gibran and Aline attend Jalal's party.

12.o: Rafi neglects Lujain at Jalal's party while Gebran steals the spotlight.

13.o: Aline starts a new job as Gibran's social media consultant. Lujain pays a visit to Jalal, unaware she's being monitored.

14.o: Lujain's secret meetings with Jalal cause tension with Rafi, driving her husband into the someone else's arms.

15.o: Jalal receives a video that threatens Rafi and Lujain’s marriage and concocts a sinister plan.

16.o: Jalal attempts to mediate Rafi and Lujain's marriage problems. Aline busies herself with ramping up Gebran's social media presence.

17.o: Qais's novel catches Gebran's curiosity, prompting him to investigate it further.

18.o: Gibran confronts Qais about the similarities between the novel and his personal story.

19.o: The suspicious similarities in the novel cause Gibran to demand reopening the criminal investigation into the suicide of a famous fashion model.

20.o: Qais comes clean to Amal. Meanwhile, Nader's father implores Jalal to rescue his son from kidnappers.

21.o: Feeling abandoned by the justice system, Laila's mother takes it upon herself to avenge her daughter.

22.o: In the aftermath of the traumatic incident, Jalal emotionally supports Lujain. Rafi, on the other hand, has trouble getting through to her.

23.o: A surprising truth about Jawdat's death threatens to expose Qais.

24.o: Rafi's suspicion is confirmed when he receives an incriminating video.

25.o: Lujain finds herself in a complicated new relationship, which causes tension between Qais and Jalal.

26.o: Gebran's health takes an unexpected turn, Lujain and Jalal hit a rough patch, and Qais gets desperate for the truth.

27.o: Revenge fuels Lujain to expose Jalal, but her actions come at a life-threatening cost.

28.o: Despite his ailing health, Gebran prepares for his fashion show. A truth about the model's death comes out.

29.o: Lujain fears for her life while Jalal goes on a rampage looking for a file that could ruin him. Adham receives a tempting offer.

30.o: Jalal's disappearance causes a dispute between Qais, Aline, and Lujain. Could he have been murdered? Or is this just a clever cover up?

1.o: Aging superhero Kotetsu, known as Wild Tiger, worries that he may lose his job on the show "Hero TV" when his sponsor company changes hands.

2.t: A Good Beginning Makes a Good Ending.
2.o: Kotetsu and Barnaby are paired up, but their differing methods prevent them from working as a team, leading to danger for Kotetsu's daughter.

3.t: Many a True Word is Spoken in Jest
3.o: Kotetsu reluctantly participates in a documentary about Barnaby, and they're both forced into action when they learn a bomb has been planted.

4.t: Fear is Often Greater Than the Danger
4.o: Ice-wielding superhero Blue Rose decides to leave the world of "Hero TV" to go back to her old life as a teenage girl named Karina who loves to sing.

5.o: Kotetsu holds a big surprise birthday party for Barnaby with the other heroes; an expensive diamond known as the "Tears of Hercules" is stolen.

6.t: Fire is a Good Servant But a Bad Master
6.o: Fire Emblem is suspected of murder after criminals arrested by Barnaby are found burned to death by peculiar blue flames in their prison cell.

7.t: The Wolf Knows What the Foul Beast Thinks
7.o: Kotetsu criticizes Barnaby for allowing a NEXT to kill the culprit they were chasing; Barnaby reveals his search for the clue to his parents' killer.

8.t: There is Always a Next Time
8.o: Stern Bild doesn't have capital punishment, but Lunatic's act of killing criminals begins to win support of the people, who praise him as an antihero.

9.t: Spare the Rod and Spoil the Child
9.o: Kotetsu is assigned to baby-sit an infant, who takes a liking to a tomboy named Dragon Kid. The next day, Dragon Kid and the baby go missing.

10.o: Barnaby has finally tracked down the whereabouts of his parents' killer; Kotetsu runs into trouble on the way to visiting his daughter.

11.o: Ouroboros demands the release of the man Barnaby was investigating, and then starts attacking the structural columns supporting Stern Bild.

12.t: Take Heed of the Snake in the Grass
12.o: Jake challenges each of the heroes to fights, stating that he will surrender if he loses but will destroy a column supporting the city if he wins.

13.t: Confidence is a Plant of Slow Growth
13.o: After the other heroes fail to defeat Jake, Barnaby steps forward to protect Stern Bild and its people -- and to get revenge for his parents' death.

14.o: Ten months after their epic battle with terrorist Jake Martinez, Tiger and Barnaby are slated to form a special unit with Blue Rose.

15.o: When Sky High falls in love with a woman he meets at a park, he turns to Fire Emblem, Blue Rose and Dragon Kid for advice on how to get close to her.

16.t: Truth Lies at the Bottom of the Well
16.o: Kotetsu doesn't like the reason Ben gives him for the recent boosts in his power; Yuri, aka Lunatic, is haunted by a past incident.

17.o: Kotetsu takes a vacation to his hometown, where he confesses his fears to his brother and makes a tough decision to keep his promise to his late wife.

18.o: Kotetsu tries to tell Barnaby that he's retiring, but he's interrupted with news that Kriem has come out of her coma.

19.o: To help Barnaby, Kotetsu suggests they retrace Barnaby's steps the day of his parents' murder, but it doesn't produce the results they hoped for.

20.t: Full of Courtesy, Full of Craft.
20.o: Samantha wants to meet with Kotetsu regarding the new information she found, but he is called away for a sudden assignment.

21.t: Heaven Helps Those Who Help Themselves
21.o: Framed for a crime he didn't commit and pursued by the other heroes, Kotetsu is cornered, but a familiar face appears.

22.t: Bad Luck Often Brings Good Luck
22.o: Kotetsu puts his plan to clear his name into action. Meanwhile, Barnaby is on his way to join the rest of the heroes.

23.o: Kotetsu and Barnaby are finally reunited, but the rest of the heroes are taken hostage by Maverick, who holds them in the Justice Tower.

24.o: Kotetsu and Barnaby take on H-01 despite having to wait for their powers to recharge, while the rest of the heroes must make a tough decision.

25.o: The heroes suffer a stunning loss and must mourn a fallen peer, while Barnaby finally encounters his parents' killer one-on-one.

1.t: A word to the wise is enough.
1.o: With exciting new heroes gaining popularity and stardom, Tiger and Barnaby are called upon to set a good example.

2.t: No one knows the weight of another's burden.
2.o: Now an official superhero, Subaru is eager to make his mark. Feeling desperate, he starts to get ahead of himself.

3.o: Karina decides to meet with a lonely and sickly fan who says Blue Rose is their favorite superhero. She asks Tiger to come along too.

4.t: Never put off till tomorrow what you can do today.
4.o: As the top-ranking superheroes, Fire Emblem and Sky High seem like the perfect buddy team; nevertheless, Nathan has one particular complaint.

5.o: After getting into an argument with Ivan, Antonio is worried that the Rock Bison and Origami Cyclone partnership won't survive.

6.t: Youth should be regarded with respect.
6.o: Lara and Pao-Lin seem to have perfect teamwork, but then Lara's overbearing mother convinces her to see Pao-Lin not as a partner, but as a rival.

7.t: Out of the mouths of babes oft times come gems.
7.o: Tiger is delighted — and a little surprised — when his daughter Kaede comes to the city to visit him with her friend.

8.t: You can‘t judge a book by it‘s cover.
8.o: Subaru gets worried when his partner Thomas is reprimanded for being too violent while apprehending a robber.

9.t: Have not thy cloak to make when it begins to rain.
9.o: Tiger bends the rules to try to catch a violent NEXT named Vincent Carl, who left Barnaby badly injured while evading capture.

10.o: Fire Emblem and Sky High are found frozen, victims of an attack by a pair of NEXT suspects who've declared war on the city's superheroes.

11.t: Every cloud has a silver lining.
11.o: Agnes orders the superheroes to stand down and avoid confrontation with Hugan and Mugan, but soon they're faced with a double threat.

12.o: The remaining superheroes learn Hugan and Mugan's motives, and then put together a plan to defeat the powerful duo.

13.t: Constant dropping wears away a stone.
13.o: The superheroes are fighting as hard as they can, but Hugan and Mugan seem impossible to defeat.

14.t: March winds and April showers bring forth May flowers.
14.o: Fire Emblem and Sky High win the King of the Buddy Heroes title. Barnaby gets some exciting news, but he has to keep it a secret.

15.o: Little is yet known about the NEXT incident, but multiple theories abound. Everyone wants to know what's going on between Kotetsu and Karina.

16.t: A friend in need is a friend indeed.
16.o: During a promo shoot, He Is Thomas declares his admiration for L.L. Audun. Then, the heroes are mobilized in response to an attack.

17.t: The gods send nuts to those who have no teeth.
17.o: As the "X" phenomenon spreads among NEXT throughout the city, Yuri gathers the heroes and gives them some bad news.

18.t: One eyewitness is better than ten hearsays.
18.o: The public has started to turn against all NEXT. Ryan thinks that a NEXT named Gregory Sunshine might be connected to the "X" phenomenon.

19.t: You cannot make a crab walk straight.
19.o: Mattia wakes up in the hospital, but he claims to not remember anything that happened. There may be a NEXT with the ability to control other people.

20.t: The darkest hour is just before the dawn.
20.o: The Apollon heroes are all told to sign new contracts putting excessive restrictions on what they can do. Yuri shares a story about his father.

21.o: Before the heroes' evacuation, Agnes asks them to gather for one last farewell taping. But she might have something up her sleeve.

22.t: Coming events cast their shadows before.
22.o: Gregory powers up the inmates of Abbas Prison and they start rampaging throughout the city. The heroes go rogue to stop them, despite the consequences.

23.t: Lookers-on see most of the game.
23.o: Gregory Sunshine has one last inmate to meet; a criminal with incredible powers. Meanwhile, the heroes struggle to neutralize the escaped NEXT.

24.o: Sigourney Rosicky reveals the reason for her vendetta against Little Aurora. The heroes get an unlikely ally in their fight against L. L. Audun.

25.t: Today is not just tomorrow's yesterday.
25.o: A powered up Tiger starts attacking Barnaby, who's left drained of power and vulnerable. Later, Tiger faces a sudden change.

2.o: Teyana hosts an exclusive movie premiere party to celebrate her role in Coming 2 America, but her team isn’t pulling their weight. Still waiting to hear from the NBA, Iman enjoys precious time with his daughters. And it’s a family affair when Baby Rue gets her ears pierced.

3.t: A Baby and Bunny On The Way
3.o: It’s time for the annual Shumperts’ Easter Celebration. While Teyana makes plans for an elaborate party, including an adult Easter Egg Hunt, Coco and Carrington prepare for the arrival of their baby. And although the Shumperts are excited that this is Rue’s first Easter, Teyana is concerned that Carrington hasn’t yet proposed.

4.o: Teyana is directing, producing, and starring in a major commercial campaign in Miami; she needs her support team to step into high gear, but not everyone is up for the challenge.

5.o: Emotions run high as Teyana has emergency surgery in Miami.

6.o: Junie is frustrated with home schooling, so Teyana and Iman set out to find a school that will support her outgoing personality and creativity.

7.t: Guys Don't Glamp, But They Do Baby Showers?
7.o: Teyana encourages everyone to go on a glamping trip, but Iman is not fully onboard. So when their adventure leads them to a haunted lake Teyana's warm visions of a pampered camper instantly turns ice water cold.

8.o: Since Teyana missed out on a regular high school experience, Iman and team attempt to create the prom of Teyana's dreams.

1.o: Wanted by the law, the young fugitive Doroteo Arango opts to change his name to Francisco Villa. Now living as a bandido, Pancho Villa will become a feared and respected name in all of northern Mexico.

2.o: Pancho Villa joins the Mexican Revolution and builds a reputation on the battlefield.

3.o: Pancho Villa is unjustly imprisoned after confronting General Victoriano Huerta; while he plots his escape from prison, new President Francisco I. Medero is murdered in a treasonous coup orchestrated by Huerta.

4.o: Now serving as General of the feared Division of the North, Pancho Villa leads the attack at Torreón, Coahuila; at the end of the fighting of what would be the biggest battle of the Mexican Revolution, Pancho defeats the Federal Army loyal to Huerta, and surprises the world with his military tactics.

5.o: Pancho Villa becomes a globally recognized figure and inks a Hollywood deal to have his battles filmed, the most important being the victory at Zacatecas. Villa finally defeats Victoriano Huerta's Federal Army, but his elevated status brings confrontation with Venustiano Carranza, the political leader of the Mexican Revolution.

6.o: Pancho Villa joins forces with Emiliano Zapata, commander of the South, in a confrontation with Venustiano Carranza and Álvaro Obregón's army, giving way to a bloody civil war. Villa and Zapata capture the capital of the country, but Carranza mounts an offensive with the backing of the United States government.

7.o: With Pancho Villa at the helm, the Division of the North is overwhelmed by General Álvaro Obregón's modern strategies of war, having applied tactics from conflicts in Europe. A series of battlefield losses bring the revolution's key figures to a breaking point, unveiling their darkest side yet.

8.o: In a desperate attempt to reverse his bad luck, Pancho Villa escapes to the border to remake his army, but he suffers a final defeat thanks to the support provided by the United States government to the Carrancista army. With his best friends and allies all dead, in exile, or in some cases, fighting on the other side, Pancho Villa disappears and vows revenge.

9.o: Blinded by rage, Villa attacks the United States on its territory in Columbus, New Mexico, seeking to provoke an invasion and thereby, enabling him to lead the defense of his country. Supported by Carranza, the United States army sends thousands of boots into northern Mexico, but the operation is an all-around failure, as the inability to capture the Centaur of the North elevates Villa's already legendary persona.

10.o: Recognized as a feared warrior and perpetual threat, Villa finally accepts a peace deal with the government of President Álvaro Obregón that will enable him to step away from public life; Pancho Villa begins a successful social project on his land, demonstrating that a more just society is possible in Mexico. But concern that another armed uprising, with Villa at the helm, coupled with unsettled debts of violence, brings about a plot to assassinate the leader, thus giving life to the immortal legend of the Centaur of the North.

1.o: As a hurricane bears down on Miami, things are equally stormy in the Maguire ER, where a serious allegation has opened rifts between the residents.

2.o: The worsening storm overwhelms the ER, forcing Danny to make tough choices. Tom must rise to the occasion when someone close to him is injured.

3.o: As the hospital's backup generators run low, Dr. Cruz worries for Vero's safety. Sophie and Camila risk it all to save a patient in danger.

4.o: With the ER at capacity post-storm, Danny struggles to balance a full caseload and the arrival of a new attending — who has a history with Xander.

5.o: A charismatic sheriff's deputy sets his sights on Danny. A young patient's demanding parents make things hard for Harper. Sophie faces a moral dilemma.

6.o: A hometown visit to their difficult father reopens fault lines between Danny and Harper. Tom and Dr. Soriano's day off takes an unexpected turn.

7.o: Danny and Sam undergo Dr. Cruz's scrutiny as she prepares to choose next year's chief resident. Camila looks for clues to a girl's mysterious illness.

8.o: As they await an interview with HR, Danny and Xander reckon with their painful past. A crisis brings Tom's divided loyalties to light.

9.o: A nightclub fire floods the ER with patients. With Danny's career hanging in the balance, Dr. Cruz must make a difficult decision.

10.o: Xander comes clean about what really happened at his former hospital. A new academic year brings a new chief resident — and new challenges in the ER.

1.o: Unable to accept that her daughter is growing up, Margarita Seisdedos takes on everyone — even the press — as music sensation Tamara emerges in Madrid.

2.t: The Strange Case of Dr. Leonardo and Mr. Dantés
2.o: Caught between two versions of himself, songwriter Leonardo Dantés delivers Tamara hit record "No cambié," but TV stunts and scandals pull them apart.

3.t: Loly Álvarez and Arlekin in the Lost Highway
3.o: It's a car crash waiting to happen: Claiming Tamara stole her song, Loly Álvarez seeks revenge while becoming infatuated with the eccentric Arlekin.

4.t: Bring Me the Head of Paco Porras
4.o: Taken captive by a cult, famed vegetable fortune teller, Paco Porras, recalls his secret mission to silence Tamara and the curse that ruined his life.

5.t: Tony Genil and the Bohemian Shadows
5.o: Madrid, 2016: Tony Genil and the gang devise a plan to humiliate Yurena after she is evicted from "Survivor," but Michael Jackson has his doubts.

6.t: The Ballad of Marimar Cuena Seisdedos
6.o: A grieving Marimar, one who never became famous, discovers a portal and embraces life as Yurena in a world where she followed her dreams of being a star.

1.o: Lady Cho masks her unease when Lord Yoo takes a young concubine for an heir. Later, she writes to her cousin Cho Won with an idea.

2.o: Lady Cho and Cho Won, the era's most notorious seducer, begin a dangerous game. They set their sights on a virtuous woman who may not bend so easily.

3.o: Cho Won approaches Hui-yeon directly, stirring her grief and testing her faith. He then provokes Lady Cho with a move that could give him the upper hand.

4.o: Cho Won once hid his longing for Lady Cho with nights spent with courtesans, yet the void remained. As he pursues Hui-yeon, his facade begins to fade.

5.o: Lady Cho exploits So-ok's secret feelings for another man. Meanwhile, complicated emotions overwhelm Cho Won as his relationship with Hui-yeon deepens.

6.o: Lady Cho warns Cho Won that the bet will stain his honor and family name — but he vows to see their dangerous game through as feelings grow.

7.o: Cho Won and Hui-yeon grow closer as they enjoy a brief respite together away from the public eye — until a royal order threatens their peace.

8.o: As the scheme spirals out of control, Lady Cho faces a reckoning with Cho Won and Hui-yeon. How far will she go to see her plan through to the end?

1.o: While investigating a murder, DI Emma Crane and DI Tom Radley uncover serious misconduct within Wakestead Police Station.

2.o: Emma's discovery of shocking video evidence leads to an unexpected breakthrough in the case, and she has no choice but to turn on one of her own.

3.o: With a key suspect exonerated, Emma is unable to shake her suspicion that a serial predator is operating within Wakestead Police Station.

4.o: Emma uncovers a potential lead to Sophie's killer as a link to another victim is discovered.

5.o: A suspect is brought in for questioning. Emma seeks help from an unlikely ally to bring her one step closer to Sophie's killer.

6.o: Things come to a head when the identity of the serial abuser is finally revealed, but Emma uncovers a further clue, forcing a devastating confrontation.

1.o: يستقبل "كالفن بيني" أسرته العائدة إلى الديار في لقاء طال انتظاره، بينما يثير وافد غير متوقع موجة من الضجة في بلدة "سنوكس آرم" الساحلية.

2.o: يتعاون "كالفن" مع د. "فوندا هواندر"، الباحثة في علوم البحار، للتحقيق في أحداث غريبة، فيما يحاول ابنه "وايد" فهم أحلامه المقلقة.

3.o: يصادف "وايد" و"كالفن" غرباء يكتنفهم الغموض، وتحذّر "فوندا" أهالي البلدة من خطر قادم من البحر، وسط تصاعد القلق في أرجائها.

4.t: The Ocean Will Have Us All
4.o: بينما يدفع بعض الغرباء "كالفن" إلى خوض مطاردة محفوفة بالمخاطر بحثًا عن المخلوق، يبدأ خطر خفي بالاقتراب من أسرته وسائر سكان البلدة.

5.o: يكشف "كالفن" حقائق صادمة عن ماضيه، وتتوصل "فوندا" إلى اكتشاف مذهل مع وصول مجموعة من الزوار على نحو غير متوقع.

6.o: مع انكشاف الدوافع الحقيقية وراء الأزمة وبدء عملية الإجلاء، يضع "كالفن" وعائلته و"فوندا" خطة محفوفة بالمخاطر لإنقاذ بلدتهم.
